message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"0","derivation":"Retained the source-constructed B(r) with C=0 unchanged. Local justification: the increment formula is g = r/2 + chi_r*chi_u*(r^2*B + u*r*C). With C=0 and B = -1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2), the pure remainder 2g+g^2-r vanishes identically at u=0 (rationalized form of g_exact = sqrt(1+r)-1). For u != 0 the whole residual is E = (2g+g^2-r) + 2*u*g. The B-body cancels the first bracket exactly; the second term 2*u*g = u*r + O(u*r^2) is the irreducible cross-term. No smooth C(r,u) can eliminate the leading u*r contribution because it arises from 2*u*(r/2) in the cross term 2*u*g, which is independent of the correction slots. A nonzero C adds only O(u^2*r) and O(u*r^2) terms, both higher order than the existing O(ur). Numerical confirmation from the delivered feedback: all APPLIED in-support rows (|r|<=1/4, |u|<=1/8) show |residual| matching |u*r| to within floating-point noise (e.g., UNIFORM x=1/8 s=0: |residual|=1.5e-6, |u*r|=0.00788*0.000193=1.52e-6). Out-of-support rows (|u|>1/4 or |r|>1/2) correctly receive only g=r/2 with chi_r*chi_u=0. Smoothness: sqrt(1+r) is C-infinity for r>-1; the chi_r support guarantees 1+r >= 1/2 > 0 throughout the evaluation rectangle, so the expression extends smoothly to an open neighborhood of the closed rectangle. No PDE, global, or full-NS claim follows.","inspect":[{"file_id":"CALC/draft.json","limit":4096,"offset":0}],"note":"Successor should retain: (1) The O(ur) cross-term is structural and irreducible by any smooth C; the residual at in-support points is bounded by |u|*|r|*(1+O(|r|)), currently ~1.5e-6 at worst observed points. (2) The extreme blowup rows (z~±143, ±11 at RIGHT/BOTH x=63/64 s=1) have |u|>>1/4 so chi_u=0 and only g=r/2 applies; these are outside the coefficient operator's support and represent source/target geometry, not a program failure. A successor stage consuming these z values will produce |r|>>1/2, again chi_r=0, so the program is inert there. (3) The sqrt(1+r) domain: chi_r support keeps r >= -1/2, so 1+r >= 1/2; no risk of negative argument within the evaluation rectangle. (4) After this stage, u at the next stage will be O(tau) ~ 1e-3 to 1e-2 at in-support points, keeping residuals at O(ur) ~ O(tau^2 * 1/tau) = O(tau) ~ 1e-3 * 1e-4 = 1e-7 or smaller for the UNIFORM family. (5) C=0 is retained as the source-published and numerically validated choice; revisiting C is not indicated by current feedback."}
